event_description: Timed 3km route around campus perimeter; participants start together but run at their own pace with personal headphones permitted—no grouping or pacing support.

At the lunch rush peak, the queue at the main serving window has just cleared — only two adjacent stainless-steel trays remain on the return conveyor belt, and both arrive simultaneously to deposit theirs.

The rusted metal access door to the experiment building rooftop is ajar; both reach the threshold at the same moment, one ascending the final stair, the other descending — with only enough space for one person to pass through sideways.
